title: kith-jmap: max_size_request and max_size_upload in build_session are magic literals
description: build_session advertises max_size_upload=104_857_600 and max_size_request=10_485_760 as standalone literals. max_size_upload matches kith_core::MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES but is not referenced from it. max_size_request has no corresponding constant at all. If the HTTP body limit changes, the session description lies to clients. Fix: introduce MAX_REQUEST_BYTES constant in kith-core and reference both from build_session.
